title: ThreatScope: Code, Decision Records and Relevance Labels for “One Digit, Different Decisions”

creators.name: Yavanoğlu, Uraz
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Engineering, Gazi University, Ankara, Türkiye

description:
Text-free reproducibility release for the manuscript One Digit, Different Decisions: Quantization-Dependent Prompt Sensitivity of Language Models in Cyber Threat Intelligence (submitted to Applied Artificial Intelligence). It contains code, protocols, configuration, per-call model decisions with their hashes, analysis outputs, independent audits, the annotation kit, and the human and AI-generated relevance labels keyed by window and target index. No third-party report text is included.
